parsed.why: Adds an enforceable facility ban (schools extended 2025) plus a narrow sexual-intent bathroom misdemeanour and 'worst policies' tier, with no state hate-crime or discrimination recourse. No documented arrest, violence or custody harm; resident care bans are climate signals only.

Documented state-implicated harm: mob beating with victims charged, hospital care denied, men's jail placement and male search despite female ID; severe municipal restroom ordinance; no state GI protection. Kill-rate figure is an admitted undercount floor, given no weight.

Facility restriction in state-run buildings, birth-marker changes effectively closed and no state GI protection or hate-crime coverage, but no documented enforcement, violence or custody harm, and strong public support (78%) plus embedded third-gender traditions temper the rating.

Only dossier with working protections: 2013 gender-identity anti-discrimination covering accommodations, GI hate-crime enhancement, no facility ban, easy marker change, no documented anti-trans incidents. National entry and document regime still caps it below the Reduced Risk band.

Statewide facility exclusion reaching airports, parks, schools and government buildings, criminal trespass with one arrest (dismissed on standing), DMV fraud treatment of marker mismatch, adult care barriers and travel advisories. Universal exposure with no working remedy outweighs its national-line violence rate.
